description: Run an allowed Orderly CLI command with structured arguments. Prefer a dedicated tool when one exists; use this for commands that do not have one. Call orderly_commands first to get exact argument names, enums and required flags. Examples: algo_order_place, order_edit, order_get, trades, funding_rates, symbols, predict_rounds. Mutating commands execute immediately unless they support dry_run and it is set to true — always preview first. Wallet import/export, key removal and auth administration are never available. Pass network to override the default.

args.description: Structured arguments keyed by the names returned by orderly_commands, e.g. {"symbol":"PERP_ETH_USDC","side":"BUY"}. Put network here, or use the top-level network field.

command.description: CLI command name, e.g. "order-place" or "order_place". Must appear in orderly_commands.

network.description: Network override for this call. Takes precedence over args.network. Defaults to ORDERLY_MCP_NETWORK, then the CLI config.

name: orderly_run
title: Run an Orderly CLI command
